item.title: Trump confronts ‘bad part of war’ as troops killed in Iran conflict return home
item.summary: Trump joined grieving families at Dover Air Force Base for a dignified transfer as the remains of the first troops killed in the Iran war returned to the U.S.

item.title: Pakistani man convicted in Iran-backed plot to kill Trump
item.summary: Asif Merchant’s case played out amid a broadening conflict in the Middle East. He was accused of working with the Iranian government to kill high-ranking U.S. officials.

item.title: Intel report warns large-scale war ‘unlikely’ to oust Iran’s regime
item.summary: A classified U.S. report doubts that Iran’s opposition would take power following either a short or extended U.S. military campaign.

item.title: Russia is providing Iran intelligence to target U.S. forces, officials say
item.summary: The targeting information has included the locations of American warships and aircraft in the Middle East, the officials said.

item.title: Democrats join legal challenge to Trump’s planned 250-foot arch
item.summary: “This is a straightforward issue of who’s in charge,” Sen. Angus King (I-Maine) said, citing a law that certain monuments must receive Congress’s approval.

item.title: Mass firings leave national security ranks thinned as war raises threats
item.summary: The U.S. military operation in Iran is testing a depleted Justice Department and FBI. Firings of experienced agents and prosecutors have diminished expertise to counter threats.

item.title: Tracking who Trump is appointing to fill key administration roles
item.summary: Follow President Trump’s progress filling over 800 positions, among about 1,300 that require Senate confirmation, in this tracker from The Washington Post and the Partnership for Public Service.

item.title: Clyburn isn’t sure if he’ll run again, but knows whom he’d like to succeed him
item.summary: As a debate about generational change rages in his party, the 85-year-old lawmaker weighs another run.

item.title: Republicans hope Mullin brings steady hand amid Trump’s shakeup at DHS
item.summary: If confirmed, Sen. Markwayne Mullin would oversee the sprawling agency amid falling public support for the administration’s mass deportation program.

item.title: Trump administration asks court to restore punishments for law firms
item.summary: The Justice Department told a federal appeals court that judges who blocked executive orders sanctioning several law firms had infringed on the president’s authority.
